snippet.title: New RTS + RPG game ---- "Power of the Horde" is on Steam
snippet.description:
Power of the Horde is a single-player RTS game rich with RPG elements. Choose your fation and hero, build your base and lead your army to defeat enemy. In the meanwhile, your hero can loot persists equipments during the battle, like playing an RPG game.

This game will be in Early Access on 2025.10, please add it to your Steam wishlist if you like it.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1298430/Power_of_the_Horde/

More news about this game will be on its store page above and X.
X: @stevenluo4
